title: Geologic maps of the Girard NW and Shell Bluff Landing 7.5-minute quadrangles, Barnwell and Aiken Counties, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 1998, Geologic maps of the Girard NW and Shell Bluff Landing 7.5-minute quadrangles, Barnwell and Aiken Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-107, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Two OCR'd sheets: Girard NW (page 1) and Shell Bluff Landing (page 2, mostly Georgia, not mapped). Symbols me, Qcb, Tal and Ttr read from legend boxes on the page image; OCR 'Todd' read as Todb. 63 Girard NW and 10 Shell Bluff Landing SCGS power-auger hole labels read from the map faces on page images; no logs printed. Shell Bluff Landing repeats the Girard NW unit descriptions (not recorded twice except Qes). Ten SC-relevant references kept. SUBSURFACE: Qal3 base locally higher than the adjacent Qal2 surface (no elevations printed).
